source_policy: Immutable source mirror unchanged; controlled input line endings normalized by the existing catalog policy.
method: Independently define existing failing test recipes, then invoke the unchanged helper and compare actual make execution. Preserve a flat existing-rule positive control, dry-run byte control and the supplied regression script.

findings.trigger: No test target or test command exists.
findings.observed: Helper adds an echo/comment-only target; make test returns zero without running tests.

findings.trigger: An actual failing test recipe is defined through a multi-target rule, included file or expanded target name.
findings.observed: The line-based detector misses the rule. The appended recipe replaces it; make test returns zero without executing the original test recipe.

maintained_response: C++ overlay requires inspecting the effective source rules, preserving real recipes/failure statuses and avoiding the original target appender. Its scaffold does not generate a test target.
limitations: GNU Make 4.3 and Bash 5.2.21 in the already admitted Linux image only.
The full target guide was not validated; packaging, installation, other languages and security claims remain unqualified.

validation.scope: Local regression and manifest/workflow checks; no hosted CI or model efficacy claim. Execution metadata was finalized after the full source freeze and is checked separately.
